chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who led a people in the ʿaṣr prayer, then remembered while he was praying that he had not performed the first one. He said: “So let him make it the first prayer that he had missed, then afterward he should begin the ʿaṣr prayer anew, while the people have already completed their prayer.”

key_terms.أَمَّ: led the people in prayer as Imam
key_terms.ٱلْأُولَى: the earlier prayer, meaning the preceding obligatory prayer

ai.seo_question: What should an Imam do if he remembers during ʿaṣr prayer that he missed ẓuhr?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who begins the ʿaṣr prayer as an Imam and then remembers that he did not perform the earlier prayer. The Imam عليه السلام instructs him to count the prayer in hand as the missed earlier prayer and then to perform the ʿaṣr prayer again afterward, while the congregation’s prayer is considered completed.
